sets.name: PvP Set
sets.description: Combat HUDs, alerts, and fight helpers — everything under the pvp category.

sets.name: HUD Set
sets.description: On-screen readouts: FPS, CPS, armour, coords, keystrokes, session stats and more.

sets.name: Visual Set
sets.description: Solix Look, Zero Font, Eagler Shaders, and other visual polish packs.

sets.name: QoL Set
sets.description: Quality-of-life helpers: login, zoom, screenshots, sprint, mentions and scale.

sets.name: Install All
sets.description: Every pack bundled with the client. Already-installed packs are skipped.

packs.name: Armour Durability HUD
packs.description: Armour Durability HUD: each armour piece (plus held and offhand items) with a durability bar and percent, remaining or remaining/max, vertical or horizontal.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: Auto GG
packs.description: Says gg in chat when a game you are in ends (configurable patterns and message; optional after kills). Uses the client's rate-limited chat send (API 1.11).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Auto-Login
packs.description: Logs you in on servers where you saved a login. Passwords stay encrypted in the client and are only sent to the exact server they were saved for, once per join. Needs client API 1.6.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Chat Stacking
packs.description: Collapses repeated identical chat lines into one with an (xN) counter, and can hide lines matching your own patterns (API 1.11 chat pipeline).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Chat Timestamps
packs.description: Prefixes incoming chat lines with the time they arrived, [HH:mm] or [HH:mm:ss] (API 1.11 chat pipeline).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Clock
packs.description: Real-world time (12/24h, optional seconds and date) plus the in-game time of day. Written in Java and compiled to JS with TeaVM.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: CPS Counter
packs.description: Clicks per second for left and right mouse, as a small standalone HUD element.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: Eagler Shaders
packs.description: Six tasteful post-processing looks (ACES filmic, soft bloom, vignette, sharpen) in low/medium/high, with bloom pyramid, auto exposure, sun/moon glow placed from the camera matrix, light TAA and automatic quality step-down. Based on NT9712/eagler-shaders (Apache-2.0).
packs.author: NT9712, ported by solix-plugins

packs.name: FPS & Ping
packs.description: A tidy glass pill showing your frame rate and server ping, coloured by how healthy they are.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: Friends
packs.description: A Friends button on the title screen and pause menu: friends list with online status and server, requests, blocking, online toasts and an appear-online toggle. Uses your Solix account (the client's own sign-in; the pack never sees your password). Shows a 'not available yet' state until the friends service launches. Needs client API 1.12.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Keystrokes
packs.description: WASD, space and mouse buttons that light up in your theme colour, with clicks-per-second under the mouse keys.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: Password Hider
packs.description: While you type /login, /register and similar commands, everything after the command shows as a symbol you pick. Spaces stay visible, and the server still gets the real text. Needs client API 1.6.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Profiles
packs.description: Save and switch named setups (which packs are on plus all their settings) from a Profiles screen on the main and pause menus. A profile named after a server loads when you join it. Needs client API 1.12.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Animation Remover
packs.description: Turn off the totem pop overlay, hurt and death camera tilt, item pickup, view bob, re-equip dip and nausea warp. Needs client API 1.9.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Armour Alerts
packs.description: Warns you with a flashing HUD badge and a toast when any armour piece (or your weapon) drops below a durability threshold.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Arrow Hit Ping
packs.description: Hit marker at the crosshair when your arrow or trident lands. Client 0.4.4beta+: hits on mobs too, the target name + health under the marker and an optional extra sound.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Block HUD
packs.description: The block you're looking at: name, position, face and id. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Block Outline
packs.description: Custom colour, thickness and optional fill for the block selection outline, or hide it (API 1.11).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Clear Water
packs.description: Thins or removes underwater fog and the in-water screen overlay (API 1.11).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Click Streak
packs.description: Counts unbroken runs of your own left clicks and keeps your best streak this session. It only counts clicks, not hits.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Combat Bar
packs.description: FPS and ping in one bar, with a ping history sparkline and jitter so you can tell when the connection is shaky.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Combo Counter
packs.description: Consecutive hits with no misses, each within 2 seconds of the last. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Coords & Facing
packs.description: Your XYZ, facing direction (N, NE, E...) and exact yaw, an optional separate Direction element, dimension, and Nether/Overworld conversion.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: PvP CPS Graph
packs.description: Left and right clicks per second with a live scrolling graph of the last few seconds. Counts your own clicks only.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Custom Crosshair
packs.description: A configurable crosshair overlay (cross, dot, circle, T, X, chevron, square, diamond, triangle...) in any colour, with outline and gap options, and a target indicator that changes colour/shape when an entity is within reach.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Crystal Optimiser
packs.description: Hides an end crystal as soon as you hit it; it comes back if the server doesn't confirm. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Custom Sky
packs.description: Recolours the sky and horizon/fog, and can hide stars, clouds or the sun and moon (API 1.11).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Damage Taken
packs.description: Floating numbers for health you lose or regain, plus your last hit and total damage taken this life.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Death Counter
packs.description: Counts your deaths (when your health hits zero) and shows how long you've been alive since your last respawn.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Explosive Timer
packs.description: Countdown for primed TNT and ignited creepers near you: floating fuse text over each one (client 0.4.4beta+) and an optional HUD list.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Fight Timer
packs.description: Times each fight, starting when you begin clicking and ending after a few quiet seconds. Also shows the health you lost during it.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Freelook
packs.description: Hold a key to look around without changing the way you move. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Fullbright
packs.description: See in caves and at night without night vision (lightmap override, adjustable). Visual only. Needs client API 1.9.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Gapple Counter
packs.description: Golden apples in your inventory (not inside shulker boxes). Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: GUI Scale
packs.description: Set the in-game GUI scale in fine steps (0.5 to 4), with optional keys to step it up and down. Needs client API 1.5.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Health & Food
packs.description: Clean bars for your health and hunger with exact numbers, in hearts or HP.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Hit Color
packs.description: Changes the hurt flash colour on entities. Visual only. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Hitboxes
packs.description: Outlines hitboxes of entities you can actually see (never invisible ones or ones behind walls). Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Item Counter
packs.description: Counts any items you choose (comma list of ids, default arrows, golden apples, ender pearls) in small pills with their icons.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: PvP Keystrokes
packs.description: Compact keystrokes for PvP: WASD, both mouse buttons with CPS, plus sneak and sprint.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Kill Feed
packs.description: A compact kill feed built from chat death messages, with your own kills and deaths highlighted.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Kill Screenshot
packs.description: Takes a screenshot automatically when chat reports that you got a kill, with a small confirmation pill.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Low Fire
packs.description: Shrinks the on-screen fire overlay (adjustable). Visual only. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Low Health Warning
packs.description: A full-screen red vignette that pulses faster the lower your health is, a quick edge flash when you take damage, and an optional badge and toast.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Memory Usage
packs.description: JS heap memory used by the client (where the browser exposes it), as used/limit, percent or MB.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Name Mentions
packs.description: Pops chat lines that mention your name into a small HUD panel, with an optional toast, so you don't miss call-outs mid-fight.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: No Dynamic FOV
packs.description: Reduces or removes the FOV change from sprinting, effects and bows, with an optional FOV clamp. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: No Fog
packs.description: Removes terrain distance fog or makes it thinner; on client 0.4.4beta+ also lava, underwater, blindness and Nether / boss fog.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: No Hurt Cam
packs.description: Reduces or removes the camera tilt when you take damage. Visual only. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: No Rain
packs.description: Hides rain, snow and (optionally) lightning bolts; on client 0.4.4.3beta+ also turns down or mutes the rain and thunder sounds. Visual and audio only.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Own Nametag
packs.description: Shows your own nametag in third person (F5), with an optional prefix/suffix on it, plate/shadow tweaks for all nametags and (client 0.4.4beta+) health on nametags.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Particle Remover
packs.description: Hide particle types one by one: crystal explosions, totem pops, crits, sweeps, block breaking, potions and more. Needs client API 1.9.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Pearl Cooldown
packs.description: A thin bar under the crosshair for the ender pearl cooldown after you throw one.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Potion Counter
packs.description: Potions in your inventory (not inside shulker boxes). Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Status Effects
packs.description: Full status effect HUD: an icon per effect, level in roman numerals, time left, blinking when about to run out; can hide the vanilla effect icons. Needs client API 1.1.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Reach Display
packs.description: A crosshair ring when what you look at is within reach, plus a reach pill. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Scope Zoom
packs.description: Hold or toggle a key to zoom, with a full-screen scope mask, reticle and magnification readout while zoomed. Only narrows your own field of view.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: PvP Session Stats
packs.description: Kills (read from chat death messages), deaths (when your health hits zero), K/D and kill streaks for this session.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Shield Status
packs.description: Shows whether you hold, raise or are blocking with a shield, the axe-disable cooldown (API 1.11) and its durability.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Small Offhand
packs.description: Draws your offhand item smaller (adjustable). Visual only. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Elytra Camera Roll
packs.description: Rolls the first-person camera into turns while flying with an elytra (API 1.11 camera).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Smooth Sneak
packs.description: Eases the camera height smoothly when you sneak and unsneak instead of snapping, and (client 0.4.4beta+) sets the walking bob strength.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Speedometer
packs.description: Your own horizontal speed in blocks per second.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Sprint & Sneak Status
packs.description: Toggle sprint (tap once to keep sprinting) with an on/off setting and key, plus sprint/sneak status as pills, text ([Sprinting (Toggled)] / Sprint: ON) or an icon.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Statistics
packs.description: FPS, ping, estimated TPS, CPS and memory. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Target HUD
packs.description: Name, health, armour and distance of what you last hit. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: PvP Themes
packs.description: Two PvP-styled Solix themes: Crimson (red on dark glass) and Frostbite (icy cyan).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Timing Optimiser
packs.description: Attack cooldown bar under the crosshair that flashes when a full hit is ready. Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Toggle Sneak
packs.description: Tap sneak once to keep sneaking, tap again to stop. Releases itself while flying, on death and when you leave. Needs client API 1.12 (idles on older clients).
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Totem Counter
packs.description: Totems of Undying in your inventory (not inside shulker boxes). Needs client API 1.3.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Totem Pops
packs.description: Counts your own Totem of Undying pops this session and warns when you have none in hand.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Weapon Durability
packs.description: A durability bar for whatever you're holding, with remaining uses and a low-durability flash.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Screenshot Helper
packs.description: A one-key screenshot shortcut, a Screenshot button in the pause menu, and a little confirmation toast with a running count.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: Solix Look
packs.description: Rebuilds the game's screens in Solix style, with four levels: Classic, Glass, Tactical and Zero Minecraft (replaces the vanilla HUD; pair it with Solix Zero Font). Glass needs client API 1.6, Zero Minecraft 1.7; menus, buttons, titles and the TPS overlay 1.13; Advancements window, tabs, frames and tooltips plus Look-font titles (incl. the death screen) 1.14.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Solix Zero Font
packs.description: Replaces the Minecraft pixel font everywhere with Rajdhani (text) and JetBrains Mono (numbers). Pairs with Solix Look's Zero Minecraft style. Symbols, arrows, Latin-1 and super/subscripts filled in from DejaVu so strings never fall back to the pixel font. Fonts under the SIL Open Font License (Rajdhani, JetBrains Mono) and the DejaVu licence. Needs client API 1.7.
packs.author: solix-plugins

packs.name: Vaporwave Theme
packs.description: An example theme pack: hot pink accent, purple glass and a retro synthwave sunset behind the menus. Pick it under Settings > Appearance once enabled.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: Toggle Sprint
packs.description: Tap your sprint key once to keep sprinting, tap again to stop.
packs.author: Solix

packs.name: Smooth Zoom
packs.description: Hold (or toggle) a key to zoom in smoothly, OptiFine style. Only narrows your field of view; it can't see anything you couldn't already.
packs.author: Solix
